skill_name: Tell me why a balanced diet is important.
workflow: A balanced diet is important because it provides the body with the essential nutrients it needs to stay healthy. Eating a balanced diet helps supply the right amount of vitamins, minerals, carbohydrates, proteins, and fats in the right proportions. A balanced diet provides the body with the necessary energy it needs for daily activities, helps maintain a healthy weight, and supports proper functioning of the body.
